purpose: Teach: トレーディング/ファクト/定款/後部/圧巻/称する/用法/求職

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、トレーディング業界の研究も視野に入れろ
lines.en: Ren, keep trading industry research on your radar too.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Light emphasis on the scope—opening the aperture without urgency. Even delivery, no rush. The confidence of someone whose suggestions carry weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文に確実なファクトを盛り込みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure the paper includes solid, verifiable facts.
lines.style: Quiet commitment. Slight lean forward in the voice, eager to confirm understanding. No hesitation—this is someone taking the instruction seriously. Clean, respectful pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会の定款変更案を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren, review the society's amended bylaws.
lines.style: Businesslike, specific. Clipped delivery on the task. No softening—this is a clear directive. Steady eye contact in the voice, expecting compliance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の後部に付録を加えました
lines.en: Yes. I've added an appendix to the back of the paper.
lines.style: Report-tone, respectful. Slightly faster than before—updating, not hesitating. Formal but genuine. A small note of pride in the follow-through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、博士論文を圧巻のものにしろ
lines.en: Ren, make that doctoral thesis outstanding.
lines.style: Firmer now. Weight on 'outstanding'—not a suggestion. Expectation without threat. The tone shifts slightly, more personal. Someone who sees potential and won't let it slide.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室を「ナノ工学研究室」と称する事にしました
lines.en: Yes. I've decided to call the lab the 'Nanoengineering Research Lab.'
lines.style: Careful pride in the decision. Measured pace, presenting the choice thoughtfully. Respectful but not uncertain—this is a deliberate step. Slight lift on the lab name.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、薬の用法を正確に論文に書け
lines.en: Ren, write the medication protocols accurately in the paper.
lines.style: Precise, no room for error. Sharp emphasis on 'accurately.' The tone of someone who knows precision matters here. Brief, clear, non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。求職活動と研究の両立を図ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll balance job applications with my research.
lines.style: Steady determination, quieter than before. Acknowledging the double burden without complaint. Slight exhale—grounding the commitment. Closing note of resolve.
